quests.dispatcherQuestion: A robbery suspect is holding two shop staff inside a locked store after police arrived. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what needs to be connected first.
quests.explanation: A calm, direct phone line lets a trained negotiator talk with the suspect without putting anyone else at risk.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A crowd has gathered outside the store, blocking officers' view of the entrance. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with the onlookers.
quests.explanation: Moving the crowd back gives officers a clear, safe view of the entrance and keeps bystanders out of danger.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The suspect has agreed to release the staff unharmed and leave the store peacefully. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the final, careful action once everyone is released.
quests.explanation: Guiding everyone to safety calmly completes the response once the suspect has agreed to cooperate.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A bag has been left unattended on a busy train platform for over an hour. Input security code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with the people nearby.
quests.explanation: Clearing the platform keeps people safe at a distance while the bag is properly checked.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Security staff have checked the bag and found only clothes and a book inside. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the bag is cleared.
quests.explanation: Once the bag is confirmed safe, the platform can reopen and trains can run as normal.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A different unattended bag is reported at the same station an hour later. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist team trained for this.
quests.explanation: A second unattended bag needs specialist checking, since staff should not handle a suspicious item themselves.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Local water tests show bacteria far above the safe limit for a whole town. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the public instruction that must be issued.
quests.explanation: A boil water notice tells residents how to make their water safe until the supply is fixed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Several families in the affected area have no way to boil water during a power cut. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be brought to them instead.
quests.explanation: Bottled water gives an immediate safe supply to households who cannot boil their own.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the water supply is now clean and safe to drink again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the earlier notice.
quests.explanation: Lifting the notice tells residents clearly that they can safely use tap water again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers detect a crack in the main support beam of a footbridge over a river. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the bridge right away.
quests.explanation: Closing the bridge immediately keeps anyone from being on it if the crack worsens.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A queue of pedestrians has formed and some are trying to cross the closed footbridge anyway. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be placed to stop people crossing.
quests.explanation: A visible guard stops people ignoring the closure and putting themselves at risk.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers finish emergency repairs and confirm the footbridge is now safe to use. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen once repairs are confirmed.
quests.explanation: Reopening only after formal confirmation ensures the public is never at risk from an unfinished repair.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A crush of fans near the stage has left several people struggling to breathe. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed given more than one person is hurt.
quests.explanation: With several people affected at once, more than one ambulance is needed to treat everyone quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Parked cars are blocking the route ambulances need to reach the crowded festival stage. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must happen to the blocked path.
quests.explanation: A clear route lets ambulances reach patients within minutes instead of being stuck in traffic.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The local hospital needs advance warning that many patients may arrive at once. Input code!
quests.hint: Say who needs to be told, and stress urgency.
quests.explanation: Early warning lets the hospital prepare extra staff and beds before patients start arriving.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A hospital's computer system has suddenly locked staff out of patient records. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the backup method staff should use instead.
quests.explanation: Paper records let staff keep treating patients safely while the computer problem is fixed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: IT staff confirm the computer lockout was caused by a hacking attempt. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what must be cut off to stop it spreading.
quests.explanation: Disconnecting the network stops the attack from reaching other hospital computers and equipment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: IT staff have a safe, saved copy of the hospital's records from yesterday. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be used to bring records back.
quests.explanation: A safe backup copy lets the hospital restore its systems without paying any ransom.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A fire has broken out in the kitchen of a busy hotel restaurant. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle firefighters arrive in.
quests.explanation: A hotel kitchen fire needs a full crew, since it can spread quickly through vents into guest rooms.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hotel guests are being told to gather at a safe meeting point outside. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what staff should do with the guests.
quests.explanation: Calm, clear direction gets guests to safety quickly without anyone panicking in the smoke-filled corridors.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Staff are counting guests against the hotel's check-in list at the meeting point. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what the count is trying to prove.
quests.explanation: Confirming the count against the guest list tells firefighters whether anyone may still be inside.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Two hikers are stranded on a mountainside as fog rolls in and visibility drops. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Ask for the team trained for this kind of terrain.
quests.explanation: Mountain rescue teams carry the right gear and training for reaching stranded hikers safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: One hiker has a suspected broken leg and cannot walk down. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed to move someone who can't walk.
quests.explanation: A stretcher team can carry him down safely without him putting weight on the injured leg.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Thick fog has made it too dangerous for the rescue helicopter to fly. Input code!
quests.hint: Say who should go instead of the helicopter.
quests.explanation: A ground team can reach the hikers on foot when poor visibility grounds the helicopter.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Several travelers at an airport have developed the same fever and cough within hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with the sick group.
quests.explanation: Isolating them quickly stops the illness from spreading to other passengers before it's understood.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Health staff need to identify who else may have sat near the sick travelers. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to find others at risk.
quests.explanation: Tracing nearby passengers lets health staff warn and check on people before symptoms even start.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Test results confirm the illness is a common flu strain, not anything more serious. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can now be lifted, given the good news.
quests.explanation: Ending the isolation once test results are clear avoids holding healthy travelers longer than needed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A small industrial boiler has begun overheating at a laundry facility. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say the first action to stop the overheating.
quests.explanation: Shutting the boiler down removes the heat source before pressure can build to a dangerous level.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Pressure inside the boiler is still rising even after the shutdown. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what lets built-up pressure safely escape.
quests.explanation: The relief valve releases pressure safely, exactly as it's designed to do in this situation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the boiler has cooled and pressure is back to a safe level. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be confirmed once pressure is normal.
quests.explanation: A formal all-clear lets workers return once engineers confirm the boiler is genuinely safe again.
